converted.personality_traits: Cheerful and full of jokes to put others at ease, but this masks his deep grief over the loss of his previous unit. Sila's trust in Eirik and Kira has grown after the safe return of her chest, strengthening their reputation at the outpost.
converted.ideals: Redemption. Every life saved is a step toward atoning for the lives he failed to save.
converted.bonds: Carries a dog tag from his fallen unit as a constant reminder of his promise to protect others. Has earned Sila's continued support and access to her supplies following the recovery of her chest.
converted.flaws: Reckless in the face of danger, terrified of losing friends again and willing to take great risks to prevent it.

converted.personality_traits: I watch over my friends as if they were a litter of newborn pups. Recently recognized by the community for my marksmanship and bravery, which has lifted my spirits and morale. Assisted in the final sweep of the stronghold. Assisted in subduing the last bandit warrior.
converted.ideals: Change. Life is like the seasons, in constant change, and we must change with it. I now strive to be a beacon of hope and courage for those around me.
converted.bonds: An injury to the unspoiled wilderness of my home is an injury to me. My bond to the Rangers' Outpost and its people has grown stronger with their recognition. Witnessing the breaking of the Withered Hart's curse has deepened my emotional bond with Eirik.
converted.flaws: I remember every insult I've received and nurse a silent resentment toward anyone who's ever wronged me. However, I am learning to put aside grudges to focus on the greater good.
